Put rubric PDF files in this folder using event-id filenames.

Required filenames for current events:
- accounting1.pdf
- business-management.pdf
- economics.pdf
- marketing.pdf
- personal-finance.pdf
- entrepreneurship.pdf
- cyber-security.pdf
- public-speaking.pdf
- impromptu.pdf

Example path:
public/rubrics/accounting1.pdf

When a file exists, the Resources screen "Open" button will load:
/rubrics/<event-id>.pdf
